CustomField.label: Field API Name
CustomField.description: The API name of the field shown in this column, without a namespace prefix; or a field of a related record, reached through up to five lookups, such as Account.Industry.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the field to show, such as Amount or My_Field__c, without a namespace prefix. For a field of a related record, put the lookups first, as a report or formula does: Account.Industry, or Account.Owner.Email. Up to five lookups.
